title: ai_forecast version 2 is now generally available
body: Version 2 of the `ai_forecast` function is now generally available in Databricks SQL. A research-optimized time series foundation model powers version 2 for improved out-of-the-box accuracy, and version 2 adds built-in holiday support, external covariates, and non-negative forecasts. See [`ai_forecast` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_forecast).
